candidate_projection: task.md only; no supplementary cautions, routes, references, rubric or design metadata
acceptance_policy: All valid shorter proofs and legal counterexamples are accepted. No proof length, advanced vocabulary, source citation count or author-route requirement.
evaluator_changes: Only the ambiguous critical_errors entry is narrowed: finite residual/completeness are errors only when silently assumed as original data; explicit conditional theorems remain valid contributions.

formal/COVERAGE.md adds existing source-audit boundaries: pathwise L-products, pointwise stopping versus uniform depth, partition/System and input transports, spectral reindexing, original-target final assembly, and the conditional Cauchy interpretation. No .lean or build input changes.
minimal_completion_criterion: A legal counterexample refuting at least one universal existence, pointwise uniqueness or uniform geometric-convergence requirement completes the conjunctive strong target.
Constructive results and explicit conditional theorems are separately credited, without being silently promoted to original-target completion.

shortest_valid_completion.route: Positive half-line, one node/self-loop, U={1}, empty stop set, b(1)=1, a(y)=y/2, L=1/2: a fixed output must be zero, which is outside the allowed nonabsorbing output space.
shortest_valid_completion.static_difficulty: low for an expert who sees this counterexample; one prior sample per model is not a reliable general difficulty estimate
